method: Built-in imagegen image editing (not API mode), one edit per source photograph.
style: Previously approved gentle realistic color instant-film, borderless and without text.
note: Generative image editing preserves the overall scene but may change fine details; this is not a pixel-identical conventional color filter. Originals were not overwritten.

images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer with strict photographic scene preservation. IMAGE 1 is the ONLY EDIT TARGET, an original wildlife photograph. IMAGE 2 is ONLY the previously approved gentle instant-color film rendering reference; NEVER copy its animal, pose, reeds, water or composition. Apply matching mild photographic COLOR GRADING and fine film texture to image 1. Deliver exactly ONE full-bleed photograph, same entire original framing and aspect ratio, no crop or zoom, no paper, white border, text, labels, UI or montage. LOCK original animal count, identity, anatomy, proportions, facial expression, eyes, mouth and paws, wet/dry fur patterns, tail, position, scale in frame, action, occlusions, all vegetation, debris, reflections, water structure and lighting direction. Do not add/delete/move any scene elements or change pose. Do not invent anatomical detail or replace the animal with a cuter/sharper version. Maintain existing optical focus/depth and atmospheric context. Approved look: moderately deeper but readable shadows, very subtle cool blue-gray shadow color, natural warm brown fur, softened/nuanced green and electric-blue saturation, creamy smooth highlight rolloff without losing detail, subtly soft photographic microcontrast instead of artificial digital sharpness, delicate fixed organic fine film grain, very restrained broad corner shading. Preserve genuine differences in natural light and water color between sources: pale gray, gray/brown or olive water should retain their natural source colors, not become uniformly blue. Same refined fresh instant-film character as reference 2, NOT heavy aged film. No scratches, dirt, orange leaks, heavy purple/cyan casts, strong vignette, painting, brushwork, drawing, fake glow, bloom haze, false shallow depth of field, artificial background replacement, excessive HDR or sharpened synthetic fur. Keep eyes/noses and important species details readable but preserve source softness. Output high-resolution, realistic photographic edit.

Source 10: landscape frame with original aspect ratio 2048:1484. One large round muskrat sits just behind a diagonal dark mossy log occupying the entire bottom foreground, animal facing right in three-quarter profile. Keep mouth slightly parted as in original, small rounded ear, eye, whiskers and tail extending left along waterline. Retain broad pale near-white gray water background, all foreground thin branches and original log detail/occlusions. Do not turn this soft overcast scene into direct sunlight or add strong colored shadows. Preserve entire tail and foreground log.
